SOLUTION (a) At ﬁrst sight, the given equation may appear somewhat bafﬂing. How is it possible to connect the left side to the right side? Connections can often be made through one of the principles of problem solving: introduce something extra. Here the extra ingredi- ent is a new variable. We often think of introducing a new variable when we use the Substitution Rule to integrate a speciﬁc function. But that technique is still useful in the present circumstance in which we have a general function f.
